summary: {member} asks an engraver to preserve the look of a printed cartoon when it moves from paper to metal.
realLife: Members wanted Franklin's divided-snake cartoon to read as newspaper art on the coin and requested shallow relief, period lettering and an indication of its origin.
inGame: needs: the printed original and the size available for its credit.

turns.what: The artist tries a flatter copy with a source credit.
turns.writesBack: The cartoon can be recognized in the proof.

turns.pulledBy: The credit becomes illegible when reduced.
turns.what: Readers cannot make out the source at coin size.
turns.writesBack: The designer asks which words can be shortened.
